mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, employee_name, id_card, phone, email, department, position, entry_date, daily_wage, salary_status, remark, tenant_id, delete_flag, create_time, update_time, creator, updater FROM jsh_salary_profile WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT department, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(daily_wage) as avgDailyWage, SUM(daily_wage) as totalDailyWage FROM jsh_salary_profile WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = '0' AND salary_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY department ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT id, employee_id, employee_name, id_card, phone, email, department, position, entry_date, daily_wage, salary_status, remark, tenant_id, delete_flag, create_time, update_time, creator, updater FROM jsh_salary_profile WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delete_flag = '0' AND salary_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATEDIFF(DATE_ADD(entry_date, INTERVAL 1 YEAR), CURDATE()) <= #{days} ORDER BY entry_date ASC
